# OSPF Configuration
# NOTE: OSPF via OpenConfig gNMI is not supported on Nokia SR Linux.
# The OpenConfig ospfv2 container is defined in the YANG model but not
# exposed in the Nokia SRL gNMI schema. EnsureOSPF returns UnsupportedField.
-- ospf/ospf --
apiVersion: networking.metal.ironcore.dev/v1alpha1
kind: OSPF
metadata:
  name: ospf
  namespace: default
spec:
  deviceRef:
    name: device
  instance: UNDERLAY
  routerId: 10.0.0.10
  interfaceRefs:
    - name: lo0
      area: "0.0.0.0"
      passive: true
    - name: ethernet-1-1
      area: "0.0.0.0"
-- state --
{}
